# Vendored TanStack Charts proof of concept

This directory contains the framework-neutral and React source packages from
[`TanStack/charts`](https://github.com/TanStack/charts) at commit
`d2c4d44ffe277fb8e1bd9611a73c885b6b51b7e6`.

The upstream packages are currently private, unpublished `0.0.0` proof-of-
concept packages. They are vendored so this experiment is reproducible until
official packages are published. Tests and unrelated adapters were omitted.

The source is provided under the upstream MIT license in `LICENSE`.
